title: Enable Remote API
desc: Run a small HTTP API so other programs (scripts, dashboards, automation tools) can read machine status and the console, list files and optionally upload G-code. The API cannot start jobs, move the machine or change settings.

title: Listen Address
desc: 127.0.0.1 accepts connections from this computer only. 0.0.0.0 accepts connections from your local network. Do not expose it to the internet.

title: Port
desc: TCP port the API listens on.

title: Access Token
desc: Clients send this as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. A random token is generated when the API is enabled with this field empty. Clear it and apply to generate a new one.

title: Allow G-code Uploads
desc: Allow clients to upload files into /sd/gcodes while the machine is idle. Uploaded files are shown in the MDI log.
